Save browser work sessions and restore them later

TapStack 让你告别「标签页太多、一关全没了」的焦虑。 核心功能 - 一键保存会话：把当前所有标签页打包保存，方便随时找回 - 快速恢复：一键重新打开保存的会话，工作流无缝衔接 - 分组管理：拖拽整理标签页，自动折叠空分组 - 多设备云端同步：登录后，会话在你的所有设备间同步（数据加密存储） - 快捷操作：键盘快捷键 + 右键菜单，保存当前页 / 全部标签页快人一步 适用场景 - 下班要关电脑，明天接着干的项目 - 多任务切换，临时整理一堆打开的标签页 - 换电脑 / 换浏览器，工作环境一键迁移 数据仅在你授权的云端存储（Supabase），支持随时删除，本地与云端双重保障。 --- TapStack lets you stop worrying about "too many tabs, and they're gone the moment I close the browser." Key Features - One-click save: Bundle all open tabs into a session and find them again anytime - Instant restore: Reopen saved sessions with a single click - Group management: Drag to organize tabs, with empty groups auto-collapsed - Multi-device cloud sync: Sign in and your sessions sync across all your devices with encrypted storage - Fast actions: Keyboard shortcuts + context menu to save the current tab or all tabs in one step Great for - Wrapping up the day without losing where you left off - Switching between multiple projects with a cluttered tab bar - Migrating your workflow to a new computer or browser Your data is stored only in cloud storage you authorize (Supabase), fully deletable, with both local and cloud backups.
